The Dedukti translation drops implicit and instance arguments and maps Lean's arithmetic and logic to Informath's base (mapping.tsv); the other Mathlib constants are worded by the symbol table mathlib.dkgf, whose English wordings Informath also renders in the other languages. Constants without a wording appear as $\mathrm{name}$.

English
Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ and $N$ be additive commutative monoids such that $M$ is a module over $R$ and $N$ is a module over $R$. Let $f$ and $g$ be linear maps of $M$ and $N$. Let $S \in \wp M$ such that the span of $S$ is equal to the top. Then $f$ is equal to $g$, if and only if for all elements $s$ of $S$, $f (s)$ is equal to $g (s)$.
French
Soit $R$ un semi-anneau. Soient $M$ et $N$ des monoïdes commutatifs additifs tels que $M$ soit un module sur $R$ et $N$ soit un module sur $R$. Soient $f$ et $g$ des applications linéaires de $M$ et $N$. Soit $S \in \wp M$ tel que l'envergure de $S$ est égale à $\ToptopMACRoF$. Alors $f$ est égal à $g$ si et seulement si pour tous les éléments $s$ de $S$, $f (s)$ est égal à $g (s)$.

theorem iSup_toAddSubmonoid {ι : Sort*} (p : ι → Submodule R M) :
    (⨆ i, p i).toAddSubmonoid = ⨆ i, (p i).toAddSubmonoid := by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x => ?_) (iSup_le fun i => toAddSubmonoid_mono <| le_iSup _ i)
  simp_rw [iSup_eq_span, AddSubmonoid.iSup_eq_closure, mem_toAddSubmonoid, coe_toAddSubmonoid]
  intro hx
  refine Submodule.span_induction (fun x hx => ?_) ?_ (fun x y _ _ hx hy => ?_)
    (fun r x _ hx => ?_) hx
  · exact AddSubmonoid.subset_closure hx
  · exact AddSubmonoid.zero_mem _
  · exact AddSubmonoid.add_mem _ hx hy
  · refine AddSubmonoid.closure_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · rintro x ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hix : x ∈ p i⟩
      apply AddSubmonoid.subset_closure (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, _⟩)
      exact smul_mem _ r hix
    · rw [smul_zero]
      exact AddSubmonoid.zero_mem _
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      rw [smul_add]
      exact AddSubmonoid.add_mem _ hx hy

Submodule.iSup_inductiontheoremBasic.lean:328
An induction principle for elements of ⨆ i, p i. If C holds for 0 and all elements of p i for all i, and is preserved under addition, then it holds for all elements of the supremum of p.
Lean
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem iSup_induction {ι : Sort*} (p : ι → Submodule R M) {motive : M → Prop} {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, p i) (mem : ∀ (i), ∀ x ∈ p i, motive x) (zero : motive 0)
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) : motive x := by
  rw [← mem_toAddSubmonoid, iSup_toAddSubmonoid] at hx
  exact AddSubmonoid.iSup_induction (x := x) _ hx mem zero add

Submodule.finset_span_isCompactElementtheoremBasic.lean:361
The span of a finite subset is compact in the lattice of submodules.
Lean
theorem finset_span_isCompactElement (S : Finset M) :
    IsCompactElement (span R S : Submodule R M) := by
  rw [span_eq_iSup_of_singleton_spans]
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe]
  rw [← Finset.sup_eq_iSup]
  exact isCompactElement_finsetSup S fun x _ => singleton_span_isCompactElement x

  rcases mem_sup.1 hyy with ⟨y, hy, y', hy', rfl⟩

lemma biSup_comap_subtype_eq_top {ι : Type*} (s : Set ι) (p : ι → Submodule R M) :
    ⨆ i ∈ s, (p i).comap (⨆ i ∈ s, p i).subtype = ⊤ := by

    simpa only [map_iSup, biSup_congr this]

  exact le_biSup p hi

Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid such that $M$ is a module over $R$. Let $I$ be a set. Let $s \in \wp I$. Let $p$ be a function from elements of $I$ to submodules of $M$ over $R$. Then the supremum of the function that maps $i_{2}$ to the supremum of the function that maps $h_{3}$ to the preimage of the subtype of the supremum of the function that maps $i_{5}$ to the supremum of the function that maps $h_{5}$ to $p (i_{5})$ and $p (i_{2})$ is equal to the top.

  suffices ⨆ i ∈ s, (p i).comap (LinearMap.range f).subtype = ⊤ by
    rw [← biSup_comap_eq_top_of_surjective s hs _ this _ f.surjective_rangeRestrict]; rfl
  exact hf ▸ biSup_comap_subtype_eq_top s p

Module.BasisinductiveDefs.lean:89
A Basis ι R M for a module M is the type of ι-indexed R-bases of M.
The basis vectors are available as DFunLike.coe (b : Basis ι R M) : ι → M. To turn a linear independent family of vectors spanning M into a basis, use Basis.mk. They are internally represented as linear equivs M ≃ₗ[R] (ι →₀ R), available as Basis.repr.

    _ = v.sum fun i vi => b.repr.symm (Finsupp.single i vi) := map_finsuppSum ..
    _ = Finsupp.linearCombination R b v := by simp only [repr_symm_single,
                                                         Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]

English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid such that $M$ is a module over $R$. Assume that $I$ is finite. Let $e$ be a linear equivalence of $M$ and the set of functions from $I$ to $R$. Then the equivalence function of the basis of $e$ is equal to $e$.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $R$ un semi-anneau. Soit $M$ un monoïde commutatif additif tel que $M$ soit un module sur $R$. Supposons que $I$ est fini. Soit $e$ une équivalence linéaire de $M$ et l'ensemble de fonctions de $I$ dans $R$. Alors la fonction d'équivalences de la base de $e$ est égale à $e$.
Czech
Nechť $I$ je množina. Nechť $R$ je polookruh. Nechť $M$ je aditivní komutativní monoid takový, že $M$ je modul nad $R$. Předpokládejme, že $I$ je konečné. Nechť $e$ je lineární ekvivalence $M$ a množiny funkcí z $I$ do $R$. Tedy funkce ekvivalence báze $e$ je rovná $e$.
Formula
$I , R , M \in \mathrm{Set} , \mathrm{Semiring} (R), \mathrm{AddCommMonoid} (M), \mathrm{Module} (R , M), \mathrm{Finite} (I), e \in \mathrm{LinearEquiv} (\operatorname{id} (R), M , I \rightarrow R)\vdash \EqtMACRoDG {\operatorname{equivFun} (\operatorname{ofEquivFun} (e))}{e}$
Proof
3 lines
1.Let $j \in M$.ext j
2.It is enough to show that $\operatorname{equivFun}$ applied to the basis of $e$, $j$ and $x'$ is equal to $e (j , x')$.ext j
3.By rewriting, $\operatorname{equivFun}$ applied to the basis of $e$, $j$ and $x'$ is equal to $e (j , x')$.simp_rw [Basis.equivFun_apply, Basis.ofEquivFun_repr_apply]

3 lines
1.Soit $j \in M$.ext j
2.Il suffit de montrer que $\operatorname{equivFun}$ appliqué à la base de $e$, $j$ et $x'$ est égal à $e (j , x')$.ext j
3.Par réécriture, $\operatorname{equivFun}$ appliqué à la base de $e$, $j$ et $x'$ est égal à $e (j , x')$.simp_rw [Basis.equivFun_apply, Basis.ofEquivFun_repr_apply]
Proof, Czech
3 lines
1.Nechť $j \in M$.ext j
2.Stačí ukázat, že $\operatorname{equivFun}$ aplikovaný na bázi $e$, $j$ a $x'$ je rovné $e (j , x')$.ext j

theorem repr_apply_eq (f : M → ι → R) (hadd : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y)
    (hsmul : ∀ (c : R) (x : M), f (c • x) = c • f x) (f_eq : ∀ i, f (b i) = Finsupp.single i 1)
    (x : M) (i : ι) : b.repr x i = f x i := by
  let f_i : M →ₗ[R] R :=
    { toFun x := f x i
      map_add' _ _ := by rw [hadd, Pi.add_apply]
      map_smul' _ _ := by simp [hsmul, Pi.smul_apply] }
  have : Finsupp.lapply i ∘ₗ ↑b.repr = f_i := by
    refine b.ext fun j => ?_
    change b.repr (b j) i = f (b j) i
    rw [b.repr_self, f_eq]
  calc
    b.repr x i = f_i x := by
      { rw [← this]
        rfl }
    _ = f x i := rfl

b.reindexRange is a basis indexed by range b, the basis vectors themselves.

def reindexRange : Basis (range b) R M :=
  haveI := Classical.dec (Nontrivial R)
  if h : Nontrivial R then
    b.reindex (Equiv.ofInjective b (Basis.injective b))
  else
    letI : Subsingleton R := not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp h
    .ofRepr (Module.subsingletonEquiv R M (range b))

theorem reindexRange_repr' (x : M) {bi : M} {i : ι} (h : b i = bi) :
    b.reindexRange.repr x ⟨bi, ⟨i, h⟩⟩ = b.repr x i := by
  nontriviality
  subst h
  apply (b.repr_apply_eq (fun x i => b.reindexRange.repr x ⟨b i, _⟩) _ _ _ x i).symm
  · intro x y
    ext i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, map_add, Finsupp.coe_add]
  · intro c x
    ext i
    simp
  · intro i
    ext j
    simp only [reindexRange_repr_self]
    apply Finsupp.single_apply_left (f := fun i => (⟨b i, _⟩ : Set.range b))
    exact fun i j h => b.injective (Subtype.mk.inj h)

Module.Basis.constrdefDefs.lean:507
Construct a linear map given the value at the basis, called Basis.constr b S f where b is a basis, f is the value of the linear map over the elements of the basis, and S is an extra semiring (typically S = R or S = ℕ).
This definition is parameterized over an extra Semiring S, such that SMulCommClass R S M' holds. If R is commutative, you can set S := R; if R is not commutative, you can recover an AddEquiv by setting S := ℕ. See library note [bundled maps over different rings].
Lean
def constr : (ι → M') ≃ₗ[S] M →ₗ[R] M' where
  toFun f := (Finsupp.linearCombination R id).comp <| Finsupp.lmapDomain R R f ∘ₗ ↑b.repr
  invFun f i := f (b i)
  left_inv f := by
    ext
    simp
  right_inv f := by
    refine b.ext fun i => ?_
    simp
  map_add' f g := by
    refine b.ext fun i => ?_
    simp
  map_smul' c f := by
    refine b.ext fun i => ?_
    simp

If b is a basis for M and b' a basis for M', and f, g form a bijection between the basis vectors, b.equiv' b' f g hf hg hgf hfg is a linear equivalence M ≃ₗ[R] M', mapping b i to f (b i).
Lean
def equiv' (f : M → M') (g : M' → M) (hf : ∀ i, f (b i) ∈ range b') (hg : ∀ i, g (b' i) ∈ range b)
    (hgf : ∀ i, g (f (b i)) = b i) (hfg : ∀ i, f (g (b' i)) = b' i) : M ≃ₗ[R] M' :=
  { constr (M' := M') b R (f ∘ b) with
    invFun := constr (M' := M) b' R (g ∘ b')
    left_inv :=
      have : (constr (M' := M) b' R (g ∘ b')).comp (constr (M' := M') b R (f ∘ b)) = LinearMap.id :=
        b.ext fun i =>
          Exists.elim (hf i) fun i' hi' => by
            rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, b.constr_basis, Function.comp_apply, ← hi', b'.constr_basis,
              Function.comp_apply, hi', hgf, LinearMap.id_apply]
      fun x => congr($this x)
    right_inv :=
      have : (constr (M' := M') b R (f ∘ b)).comp (constr (M' := M) b' R (g ∘ b')) = LinearMap.id :=
        b'.ext fun i =>
          Exists.elim (hg i) fun i' hi' => by
            rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, b'.constr_basis, Function.comp_apply, ← hi', b.constr_basis,
              Function.comp_apply, hi', hfg, LinearMap.id_apply]
      fun x => congr($this x) }

Let $X$, $I$, $R$, $M$ and $M'$ be sets. Let $b$ be a basis of $M$ over $R$. Let $b'$ be a basis of $M'$ over $R$. Let $f$ be a function from $M$ to $M'$. Let $g$ be a function from $M'$ to $M$. b.coord i is the linear function giving the i-th coordinate of a vector with respect to the basis b.
b.coord i is an element of the dual space. In particular, for finite-dimensional spaces it is the ιth basis vector of the dual space.

LinearIndependent R v states the family of vectors v is linearly independent over R.
Lean
def LinearIndependent : Prop :=
  Injective (Finsupp.linearCombination R v)

English
Let $I$, $R$ and $M$ be sets. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Then $R$ is independent over $I$, if the linear combination of $R$ and $v$ is injective.

Soient $I$, $R$ et $M$ des ensembles. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$. Alors $R$ est indépendant sur $I$ si la combinaison linéaire de $R$ et $v$ est injective.

Formula
$I , R , M \in \mathrm{Set} , v \in I \rightarrow M \vdash \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (I , R , M , v):\Leftrightarrow \operatorname{Injective} (\operatorname{linearCombination} (R , v))$

theorem linearIndependent_iff'ₛ :
    LinearIndependent R v ↔
      ∀ s : Finset ι, ∀ f g : ι → R, ∑ i ∈ s, f i • v i = ∑ i ∈ s, g i • v i → ∀ i ∈ s, f i = g i :=
  linearIndependent_iffₛ.trans
    ⟨fun hv s f g eq i his ↦ by
      have h :=
        hv (∑ i ∈ s, Finsupp.single i (f i)) (∑ i ∈ s, Finsupp.single i (g i)) <| by
          simpa only [map_sum, Finsupp.linearCombination_single] using eq
      have (f : ι → R) : f i = (∑ j ∈ s, Finsupp.single j (f j)) i :=
        calc
          f i = (Finsupp.lapply i : (ι →₀ R) →ₗ[R] R) (Finsupp.single i (f i)) := by
            { rw [Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] }
          _ = ∑ j ∈ s, (Finsupp.lapply i : (ι →₀ R) →ₗ[R] R) (Finsupp.single j (f j)) :=
            Eq.symm <|
              Finset.sum_eq_single i
                (fun j _hjs hji => by rw [Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne' hji])
                fun hnis => hnis.elim his
          _ = (∑ j ∈ s, Finsupp.single j (f j)) i := (map_sum ..).symm
      rw [this f, this g, h],
      fun hv f g hl ↦
      Finsupp.ext fun _ ↦ by
        classical
        refine _root_.by_contradiction fun hni ↦ hni <| hv (f.support ∪ g.support) f g ?_ _ ?_
        · rwa [← sum_subset subset_union_left, ← sum_subset subset_union_right] <;>
            rintro i - hi <;> rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hi, zero_smul]
        · contrapose hni
          simp_rw [notMem_union, Finsupp.notMem_support_iff] at hni
          rw [hni.1, hni.2]⟩

theorem linearIndependent_iff''ₛ :
    LinearIndependent R v ↔
      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f g : ι → R), (∀ i ∉ s, f i = g i) →
        ∑ i ∈ s, f i • v i = ∑ i ∈ s, g i • v i → ∀ i, f i = g i := by
  classical
  exact linearIndependent_iff'ₛ.trans
    ⟨fun H s f g eq hv i ↦ if his : i ∈ s then H s f g hv i his else eq i his,
      fun H s f g eq i hi ↦ by
      convert
        H s (fun j ↦ if j ∈ s then f j else 0) (fun j ↦ if j ∈ s then g j else 0)
          (fun j hj ↦ (ite_eq_right hj).trans (ite_eq_right hj).symm)
          (by simp_rw [ite_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_extend_by_zero, eq]) i <;>
      exact (ite_eq_left hi).symm⟩

lemma linearIndepOn_finset_iffₛ {s : Finset ι} :
    LinearIndepOn R v s ↔ ∀ f g : ι → R,
      ∑ i ∈ s, f i • v i = ∑ i ∈ s, g i • v i → ∀ i ∈ s, f i = g i := by
  classical
  simp_rw [LinearIndepOn, Fintype.linearIndependent_iffₛ]
  constructor
  · rintro hv f g hfg i hi
    simp_rw [← s.sum_attach] at hfg
    exact hv (f ∘ Subtype.val) (g ∘ Subtype.val) hfg ⟨i, hi⟩
  · rintro hv f g hfg i
    simpa using hv (fun j ↦ if hj : j ∈ s then f ⟨j, hj⟩ else 0)
      (fun j ↦ if hj : j ∈ s then g ⟨j, hj⟩ else 0) (by simpa +contextual [← s.sum_attach]) i

not_linearIndepOn_finset_iffₛtheoremDefs.lean:288
Lean
lemma not_linearIndepOn_finset_iffₛ {s : Finset ι} :
    ¬LinearIndepOn R v s ↔ ∃ f g : ι → R,
      ∑ i ∈ s, f i • v i = ∑ i ∈ s, g i • v i ∧ ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≠ g i := by
  simpa using linearIndepOn_finset_iffₛ.not
Dedukti
1 lines
not_linearIndepOn_finset_iff_u209b_ : (I : Set) -> (R : Set) -> (M : Set) -> (v : (Elem I -> M)) -> (_ : Proof (Semiring R)) -> (_ : Proof (AddCommMonoid M)) -> (_ : Proof (Module R M)) -> (s : Elem (Finset I)) -> Proof (iff (not (LinearIndepOn I R M v (SetLike__coe (Finset I) I s))) (exists (Elem I -> R) (f => exists (Elem I -> R) (g => and (Eqt M (Finset__sum I M s (i => HSMul__hSMul R M M (f i) (v i))) (Finset__sum I M s (i1 => HSMul__hSMul R M M (g i1) (v i1)))) (exists I (i2 => and (Membership__mem I (Finset I) s i2) (Neq (f i2) (g i2)))))))).
English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Assume that $M$ is a module over $R$. Let $s$ be a finite set of $I$. Then it is not the case that $v$ is independent on $s$ over $R$, if and only if there exist functions $f$ and $g$ from $I$ to $R$, such that $\FinsetSum {s}{i}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i)}{v (i)})}$ is equal to $\FinsetSum {s}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {g (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ and there exists an element $i_{2}$ of $I$, such that $i_{2}$ is an element of $s$ and $f (i_{2})\neq g (i_{2})$.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $R$ un semi-anneau. Soit $M$ un monoïde commutatif additif. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$. Supposons que $M$ est un module sur $R$. Soit $s$ un ensemble fini de $I$. Alors il n'est pas le cas que $v$ soit indépendant sur $s$ sur $R$ si et seulement si il existent des fonctions $f$ et $g$ de $I$ dans $R$ tel que $\FinsetSum {s}{i}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i)}{v (i)})}$ soit égal à $\FinsetSum {s}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {g (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ et il existe un élément $i_{2}$ de $I$ tel que $i_{2}$ soit un élément de $s$ et $f (i_{2})\neq g (i_{2})$.
Czech
Nechť $I$ je množina. Nechť $R$ je polookruh. Nechť $M$ je aditivní komutativní monoid. Nechť $v$ je funkce z $I$ do $M$. Předpokládejme, že $M$ je modul nad $R$. Nechť $s$ je konečná množina $I$. Tedy není případ že $v$ je nezávislé na $s$ nad $R$, právě tehdy, když existují funkce $f$ a $g$ z $I$ do $R$, takový, že $\FinsetSum {s}{i}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i)}{v (i)})}$ je rovné $\FinsetSum {s}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {g (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ a existuje prvek $i_{2}$ z $I$, takový, že $i_{2}$ je element $s$ a $f (i_{2})\neq g (i_{2})$.
Formula
$I , R , M \in \mathrm{Set} , v \in I \rightarrow M , \mathrm{Semiring} (R), \mathrm{AddCommMonoid} (M), \mathrm{Module} (R , M), s \in \mathrm{Finset} (I)\vdash \neg \mathrm{LinearIndepOn} (R , v , s)\leftrightarrow (\exists f \in I \rightarrow R . \exists g \in I \rightarrow R . \EqtMACRoDG {\FinsetSum {s}{i}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEQ {f (i)}{v (i)})}}{\FinsetSum {s}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEQ {g (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}}\wedge (\exists i_{2} \in I . \MembershipmemMACRoDX {s}{i_{2}}\wedge f (i_{2})\neq g (i_{2})))$

Let $I$ and $X$ be sets. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $s \in \wp X$. Let $v \in I \rightarrow X \rightarrow R$ such that the function that maps $i$ and $j_{1}$ to $v (i , j_{1})$ is independent over $R$. Then $v$ is independent over $R$.

Formula

2 lines

LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_injOntheoremDefs.lean:330
If f is a linear map injective on the span of the range of v, then the family f ∘ v is linearly independent if and only if the family v is linearly independent. See LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_disjoint for the version with Set.InjOn replaced by Disjoint when working over a ring.
Lean
protected theorem LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_injOn (f : M →ₗ[R] M')
    (hf_inj : Set.InjOn f (span R (Set.range v))) :
    LinearIndependent R (f ∘ v) ↔ LinearIndependent R v := by
  simp_rw [LinearIndependent, Finsupp.linearCombination_linear_comp, coe_comp]
  rw [hf_inj.injective_iff]
  rw [← Finsupp.range_linearCombination, LinearMap.coe_range]

English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ and $M'$ be additive commutative monoids. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Assume that $M$ is a module over $R$. Assume that $M'$ is a module over $R$. Let $f$ be a linear map of $M$ and $M'$ such that $f$ is injective on the span of the range of $v$. Then $\FunctioncompMACRoEM {f}{v}$ is independent over $R$, if and only if $v$ is independent over $R$.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $R$ un semi-anneau. Soient $M$ et $M'$ des monoïdes commutatifs additifs. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$. Supposons que $M$ est un module sur $R$. Supposons que $M'$ est un module sur $R$. Soit $f$ une application linéaire de $M$ et $M'$ telle que $f$ soit injectif sur l'envergure de l'image de $v$. Alors $\FunctioncompMACRoEM {f}{v}$ est indépendant sur $R$ si et seulement si $v$ est indépendant sur $R$.
Czech
Nechť $I$ je množina. Nechť $R$ je polookruh. Nechť $M$ a $M'$ je aditivní komutativní monoid. Nechť $v$ je funkce z $I$ do $M$. Předpokládejme, že $M$ je modul nad $R$. Předpokládejme, že $M'$ je modul nad $R$. Nechť $f$ je lineární zobrazení $M$ a $M'$ takové, že $f$ je injektivní na obalu rozsahu $v$. Tedy kompozice $f$ a $v$ je nezávislá nad $R$, právě tehdy, když $v$ je nezávislé nad $R$.
Formula
$I , R , M , M' \in \mathrm{Set} , v \in I \rightarrow M , \mathrm{Semiring} (R), \mathrm{AddCommMonoid} (M), \mathrm{AddCommMonoid} (M'), \mathrm{Module} (R , M), \mathrm{Module} (R , M'), f \in \mathrm{LinearMap} (\operatorname{id} (R), M , M'), \operatorname{InjOn} (f , \SubmodulespanMACRoIC {R}{\operatorname{range} (v)})\vdash \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (R , \FunctioncompMACRoEV {f}{v})\leftrightarrow \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (R , v)$
Proof
3 lines
1.It is enough to show that the composition of $f$ and the linear combination of $R$ and $v$ is injective, if and only if the linear combination of $R$ and $v$ is injective.simp_rw [LinearIndependent, Finsupp.linearCombination_linear_comp, coe_comp]
2.It is enough to show that the range of the linear combination of $R$ and $v$ is a subset of the span of the range of $v$.rw [hf_inj.injective_iff]
3.By rewriting, the range of the linear combination of $R$ and $v$ is a subset of the span of the range of $v$.rw [← Finsupp.range_linearCombination, LinearMap.coe_range]
Proof, French
3 lines
1.Il suffit de montrer que la composition de $f$ et la combinaison linéaire de $R$ et $v$ est injective si et seulement si la combinaison linéaire de $R$ et $v$ est injective.simp_rw [LinearIndependent, Finsupp.linearCombination_linear_comp, coe_comp]
2.Il suffit de montrer que l'image de la combinaison linéaire de $R$ et $v$ est un sous-ensemble de l'envergure de l'image de $v$.rw [hf_inj.injective_iff]
3.Par réécriture, l'image de la combinaison linéaire de $R$ et $v$ est un sous-ensemble de l'envergure de l'image de $v$.rw [← Finsupp.range_linearCombination, LinearMap.coe_range]
Proof, Czech
3 lines
1.Stačí ukázat, že kompozice $f$ a lineární kombinace $R$ a $v$ je injektivní, právě tehdy, když lineární kombinace $R$ a $v$ je injektivní.simp_rw [LinearIndependent, Finsupp.linearCombination_linear_comp, coe_comp]
2.Stačí ukázat, že rozsah lineární kombinace $R$ a $v$ je podmnožina obalu rozsahu $v$.rw [hf_inj.injective_iff]
3.Přepsáním, rozsah lineární kombinace $R$ a $v$ je podmnožina obalu rozsahu $v$.rw [← Finsupp.range_linearCombination, LinearMap.coe_range]

linearDepOn_iff'ₛtheoremDefs.lean:418
An indexed set of vectors is linearly dependent iff there are two distinct Finsupp.LinearCombinations of the vectors with the same value.
Lean
theorem linearDepOn_iff'ₛ : ¬LinearIndepOn R v s ↔
      ∃ f g : ι →₀ R, f ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s ∧ g ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s ∧
        Finsupp.linearCombination R v f = Finsupp.linearCombination R v g ∧ f ≠ g := by
  simp [linearIndepOn_iffₛ]

English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $s \in \wp I$. Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Assume that $M$ is a module over $R$. Then it is not the case that $v$ is independent on $s$ over $R$, if and only if there exist elements $f$ and $g$ of $\FinsuppMACRoDN {I}{R}$, such that $f$ is an element of $\operatorname{supported} (R , R , s)$, $g$ is an element of $\operatorname{supported} (R , R , s)$, $\operatorname{linearCombination} (R , v , f)$ is equal to $\operatorname{linearCombination} (R , v , g)$ and $f \neq g$.

theorem linearDepOn_iffₛ : ¬LinearIndepOn R v s ↔
      ∃ f g : ι →₀ R, f ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s ∧ g ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s ∧

LinearIndependent.reprdefDefs.lean:462
Linear combination representing a vector in the span of linearly independent vectors.
Given a family of linearly independent vectors, we can represent any vector in their span as a linear combination of these vectors. These are provided by this linear map. It is simply one direction of LinearIndependent.linearCombinationEquiv.

def LinearIndependent.repr (hv : LinearIndependent R v) : span R (range v) →ₗ[R] ι →₀ R :=
  hv.linearCombinationEquiv.symm

theorem LinearIndependent.repr_eq {l : ι →₀ R} {x : span R (range v)}
    (eq : Finsupp.linearCombination R v l = ↑x) : hv.repr x = l := by
  have :
    ↑((LinearIndependent.linearCombinationEquiv hv : (ι →₀ R) →ₗ[R] span R (range v)) l) =
      Finsupp.linearCombination R v l :=
    rfl
  have : (LinearIndependent.linearCombinationEquiv hv : (ι →₀ R) →ₗ[R] span R (range v)) l = x := by
    rw [eq] at this
    exact Subtype.ext_iff.2 this
  rw [← LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply hv.linearCombinationEquiv l]
  rw [← this]
  rfl

    Span.repr R (Set.range v) x =
      (hv.repr x).equivMapDomain (Equiv.ofInjective _ hv.injective) := by
  have p :
    (Span.repr R (Set.range v) x).equivMapDomain (Equiv.ofInjective _ hv.injective).symm =

      LinearIndependent.linearCombination_repr, Finsupp.linearCombination_equivMapDomain,
      Span.finsupp_linearCombination_repr]
  ext ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
  simp [← p]

theorem LinearIndependent.maximal_iff {ι : Type w} {R : Type u} [Semiring R] [Nontrivial R]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {v : ι → M} (i : LinearIndependent R v) :
    i.Maximal ↔
      ∀ (κ : Type v) (w : κ → M) (_i' : LinearIndependent R w) (j : ι → κ) (_h : w ∘ j = v),
        Surjective j := by
  constructor
  · rintro p κ w i' j rfl
    specialize p (range w) i'.linearIndepOn_id (range_comp_subset_range _ _)
    rw [range_comp, ← image_univ (f := w)] at p
    exact range_eq_univ.mp (image_injective.mpr i'.injective p)
  · intro p w i' h
    specialize
      p w ((↑) : w → M) i' (fun i => ⟨v i, range_subset_iff.mp h i⟩)
        (by
          ext
          simp)
    have q := congr_arg (fun s => ((↑) : w → M) '' s) p.range_eq
    rw [← image_univ, image_image] at q
    simpa using q

linearIndependent_iffₒₛtheoremDefs.lean:590
Lean
theorem linearIndependent_iffₒₛ :
    LinearIndependent R v ↔
      ∀ (s t : Finset ι) (f : ι → R), Disjoint s t →
        ∑ i ∈ s, f i • v i = ∑ i ∈ t, f i • v i → (∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0) ∧ ∀ i ∈ t, f i = 0 := by
  classical
  let : Sub R := CanonicallyOrderedAdd.toSub
  have : OrderedSub R := CanonicallyOrderedAdd.toOrderedSub
  rw [linearIndependent_iff'ₛ]
  refine ⟨fun h s t f hst heq => ?_, fun h s f g heq => ?_⟩
  · specialize h (s ∪ t) (fun i => if i ∈ s then f i else 0) (fun i => if i ∈ t then f i else 0) ?_
    · simpa
    refine ⟨fun i hi => ?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    · simpa [hi, hst.notMem_of_mem_left_finset hi] using h i (Finset.mem_union_left _ hi)
    · simpa [hi, hst.notMem_of_mem_right_finset hi] using (h i (Finset.mem_union_right _ hi)).symm
  · specialize h { i ∈ s | g i ≤ f i } { i ∈ s | f i < g i }
      (fun i => if g i ≤ f i then f i - g i else g i - f i) ?_ ?_
    · simp_rw [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact fun i ⟨_, hi⟩ ⟨_, hi'⟩ => hi.not_gt hi'
    · rw [← add_right_cancel_iff
        (a := ∑ i ∈ s with g i ≤ f i, g i • v i + ∑ i ∈ s with f i < g i, f i • v i)]
      conv_lhs => rw [← add_assoc, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      conv_rhs => rw [add_left_comm, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      convert heq
        <;> simp_rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not s (fun i => g i ≤ f i), not_le]
        <;> congr! 2 with i hi
        <;> simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hi
      · simp [hi.2, ← add_smul, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hi.2]
      · simp [hi.2.not_ge, ← add_smul, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hi.2.le]
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at h
    intro i hi
    by_cases hi' : g i ≤ f i
    · apply hi'.antisymm'
      simpa [hi', tsub_eq_zero_iff_le] using h.1 i ⟨hi, hi'⟩
    · apply (not_le.1 hi').le.antisymm
      simpa [hi', tsub_eq_zero_iff_le] using h.2 i ⟨hi, not_le.1 hi'⟩

linearIndependent_iff_u2092__u209b_ : (I : Set) -> (R : Set) -> (M : Set) -> (v : (Elem I -> M)) -> (_ : Proof (Semiring R)) -> (_ : Proof (AddCommMonoid M)) -> (_ : Proof (Module R M)) -> (_ : Proof (LinearOrder R)) -> (_ : Proof (CanonicallyOrderedAdd R)) -> (_ : Proof (IsCancelAdd M)) -> Proof (iff (LinearIndependent I R M v) (forall (Finset I) (s => forall (Finset I) (t => forall (Elem I -> R) (f => if (Disjoint (Finset I) s t) (if (Eqt M (Finset__sum I M s (i2 => HSMul__hSMul R M M (f i2) (v i2))) (Finset__sum I M t (i3 => HSMul__hSMul R M M (f i3) (v i3)))) (and (forall I (i => if (Membership__mem I (Finset I) s i) (Eqt R (f i) 0))) (forall I (i1 => if (Membership__mem I (Finset I) t i1) (Eqt R (f i1) 0)))))))))).
English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Assume that $M$ is a module over $R$. Assume that $R$ is a linearly ordered set. Assume that $R$ is a canonically ordered sum. Assume that $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Then $v$ is independent over $R$, if and only if for all finite sets $s$ and $t$ of $I$, for all functions $f$ from $I$ to $R$, if $s$ is disjoint to $t$, then if $\FinsetSum {s}{i_{2}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{2})}{v (i_{2})})}$ is equal to $\FinsetSum {t}{i_{3}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{3})}{v (i_{3})})}$, then for all elements $i$ of $I$, if $i$ is an element of $s$, then $f (i)$ is equal to $0$ and for all elements $i_{1}$ of $I$, if $i_{1}$ is an element of $t$, then $f (i_{1})$ is equal to $0$.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $R$ un semi-anneau. Soit $M$ un monoïde commutatif additif. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$. Supposons que $M$ est un module sur $R$. Supposons que $R$ est un ensemble totalement ordonné. Supposons que $R$ est une somme canoniquement ordonnée. Supposons que $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Alors $v$ est indépendant sur $R$ si et seulement si pour tous les ensembles finis $s$ et $t$ de $I$, pour toutes les fonctions $f$ de $I$ dans $R$, si $s$ est disjoint à $t$, alors si $\FinsetSum {s}{i_{2}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{2})}{v (i_{2})})}$ est égal à $\FinsetSum {t}{i_{3}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{3})}{v (i_{3})})}$, alors pour tous les éléments $i$ de $I$, si $i$ est un élément de $s$, alors $f (i)$ est égal à $0$ et pour tous les éléments $i_{1}$ de $I$, si $i_{1}$ est un élément de $t$, alors $f (i_{1})$ est égal à $0$.

Předpokládejme, že $R$ je lineárně uspořádaná množina. Předpokládejme, že $R$ je kanonicky uspořádaná suma. Předpokládejme, že $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Tedy $v$ je nezávislé nad $R$, právě tehdy, když pro všechny konečné množiny $s$ a $t$ $I$, pro všechny funkce $f$ z $I$ do $R$, jestliže $s$ je disjunktní do $t$, pak jestliže $\FinsetSum {s}{i_{2}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{2})}{v (i_{2})})}$ je rovné $\FinsetSum {t}{i_{3}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{3})}{v (i_{3})})}$, pak pro všechny prvky $i$ z $I$, jestliže $i$ je element $s$, pak $f (i)$ je rovné $0$ a pro všechny prvky $i_{1}$ z $I$, jestliže $i_{1}$ je element $t$, pak $f (i_{1})$ je rovné $0$.

$I , R , M \in \mathrm{Set} , v \in I \rightarrow M , \mathrm{Semiring} (R), \mathrm{AddCommMonoid} (M), \mathrm{Module} (R , M), \mathrm{LinearOrder} (R), \mathrm{CanonicallyOrderedAdd} (R), \mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)\vdash \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (R , v)\leftrightarrow (\forall s \in \mathrm{Finset} (I). \forall t \in \mathrm{Finset} (I). \forall f \in I \rightarrow R . \mathrm{Disjoint} (s , t)\rightarrow \EqtMACRoDG {\FinsetSum {s}{i_{2}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEQ {f (i_{2})}{v (i_{2})})}}{\FinsetSum {t}{i_{3}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEQ {f (i_{3})}{v (i_{3})})}}\rightarrow (\forall i \in I . \MembershipmemMACRoDX {s}{i}\rightarrow \EqtMACRoDG {f (i)}{0})\wedge (\forall i_{1} \in I . \MembershipmemMACRoDX {t}{i_{1}}\rightarrow \EqtMACRoDG {f (i_{1})}{0}))$

not_linearIndependent_iffₒₛtheoremDefs.lean:626
Lean
theorem not_linearIndependent_iffₒₛ :
    ¬ LinearIndependent R v ↔
      ∃ (s t : Finset ι) (f : ι → R),
        Disjoint s t ∧ ∑ i ∈ s, f i • v i = ∑ i ∈ t, f i • v i ∧ ∃ i ∈ s, 0 < f i := by
  simp only [linearIndependent_iffₒₛ, pos_iff_ne_zero]
  push +distrib Not
  refine ⟨fun ⟨s, t, f, hst, heq, h⟩ => ?_,
    fun ⟨s, t, f, hst, heq, hi⟩ => ⟨s, t, f, hst, heq, .inl hi⟩⟩
  rcases h with ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩ | ⟨i, hi, hgi⟩
  · exact ⟨s, t, f, hst, heq, i, hi, hfi⟩
  · exact ⟨t, s, f, hst.symm, heq.symm, i, hi, hgi⟩

not_linearIndependent_iff_u2092__u209b_ : (I : Set) -> (R : Set) -> (M : Set) -> (v : (Elem I -> M)) -> (_ : Proof (Semiring R)) -> (_ : Proof (AddCommMonoid M)) -> (_ : Proof (Module R M)) -> (_ : Proof (LinearOrder R)) -> (_ : Proof (CanonicallyOrderedAdd R)) -> (_ : Proof (IsCancelAdd M)) -> Proof (iff (not (LinearIndependent I R M v)) (exists (Finset I) (s => exists (Finset I) (t => exists (Elem I -> R) (f => and (Disjoint (Finset I) s t) (and (Eqt M (Finset__sum I M s (i => HSMul__hSMul R M M (f i) (v i))) (Finset__sum I M t (i1 => HSMul__hSMul R M M (f i1) (v i1)))) (exists I (i2 => and (Membership__mem I (Finset I) s i2) (Lt 0 (f i2)))))))))).
English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Assume that $M$ is a module over $R$. Assume that $R$ is a linearly ordered set. Assume that $R$ is a canonically ordered sum. Assume that $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Then $v$ is not independent over $R$, if and only if there exist finite sets $s$ and $t$ of $I$, such that there exists a function $f$ from $I$ to $R$, such that $s$ is disjoint to $t$, $\FinsetSum {s}{i}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i)}{v (i)})}$ is equal to $\FinsetSum {t}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ and there exists an element $i_{2}$ of $I$, such that $i_{2}$ is an element of $s$ and $0 < f (i_{2})$.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $R$ un semi-anneau. Soit $M$ un monoïde commutatif additif. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$. Supposons que $M$ est un module sur $R$. Supposons que $R$ est un ensemble totalement ordonné. Supposons que $R$ est une somme canoniquement ordonnée. Supposons que $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Alors $v$ n'est pas indépendant sur $R$ si et seulement si il existent des ensembles finis $s$ et $t$ de $I$ tel que il existe une fonction $f$ de $I$ dans $R$ tel que $s$ soit disjoint à $t$, $\FinsetSum {s}{i}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i)}{v (i)})}$ soit égal à $\FinsetSum {t}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ et il existe un élément $i_{2}$ de $I$ tel que $i_{2}$ soit un élément de $s$ et $0 < f (i_{2})$.

Lean
nonrec theorem Fintype.linearIndependent_iffₒₛ [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] :
    LinearIndependent R v ↔ ∀ t, ∀ (f : ι → R),
      ∑ i ∈ t, f i • v i = ∑ i ∉ t, f i • v i → ∀ i, f i = 0 := by
  rw [linearIndependent_iffₒₛ]
  refine ⟨fun h t f heq i => ?_, fun h t₁ t₂ f ht₁t₂ heq => ?_⟩
  · specialize h t tᶜ f disjoint_compl_right heq
    by_cases hi : i ∈ t
    · exact h.1 i hi
    · exact h.2 i (Finset.mem_compl.2 hi)
  · specialize h t₁ (fun i => if i ∈ t₁ ∨ i ∈ t₂ then f i else 0) ?_
    · rw [← Finset.sum_subset ht₁t₂.le_compl_left]
      · convert! heq using 2 with i hi i hi <;> simp [hi]
      · intro i hi hi'
        simp [Finset.mem_compl.1 hi, hi']
    refine ⟨fun i hi => ?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩ <;> simpa [hi] using h i

Fintype__linearIndependent_iff_u2092__u209b_ : (I : Set) -> (R : Set) -> (M : Set) -> (v : (Elem I -> M)) -> (_ : Proof (Semiring R)) -> (_ : Proof (AddCommMonoid M)) -> (_ : Proof (Module R M)) -> (_ : Proof (LinearOrder R)) -> (_ : Proof (CanonicallyOrderedAdd R)) -> (_ : Proof (IsCancelAdd M)) -> (_ : Proof (Fintype I)) -> Proof (iff (LinearIndependent I R M v) (forall (Finset I) (t => forall (Elem I -> R) (f => if (Eqt M (Finset__sum I M t (i1 => HSMul__hSMul R M M (f i1) (v i1))) (Finset__sum I M (Compl__compl (Finset I) t) (i2 => HSMul__hSMul R M M (f i2) (v i2)))) (forall I (i => Eqt R (f i) 0)))))).
English
Let $I$ be a finite type. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Assume that $M$ is a module over $R$. Assume that $R$ is a linearly ordered set. Assume that $R$ is a canonically ordered sum. Assume that $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Then $v$ is independent over $R$, if and only if for all finite sets $t$ of $I$, for all functions $f$ from $I$ to $R$, if $\FinsetSum {t}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ is equal to $\FinsetSum {\ComplcomplMACRoFU {t}}{i_{2}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{2})}{v (i_{2})})}$, then for all elements $i$ of $I$, $f (i)$ is equal to $0$.
French

Supposons que $R$ est un ensemble totalement ordonné. Supposons que $R$ est une somme canoniquement ordonnée. Supposons que $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Alors $v$ est indépendant sur $R$ si et seulement si pour tous les ensembles finis $t$ de $I$, pour toutes les fonctions $f$ de $I$ dans $R$, si $\FinsetSum {t}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ est égal à $\FinsetSum {\ComplcomplMACRoFU {t}}{i_{2}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{2})}{v (i_{2})})}$, alors pour tous les éléments $i$ de $I$, $f (i)$ est égal à $0$.

Fintype.not_linearIndependent_iffₒₛtheoremDefs.lean:654
Lean
theorem Fintype.not_linearIndependent_iffₒₛ [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] :
    ¬ LinearIndependent R v ↔ ∃ t, ∃ (f : ι → R),
      ∑ i ∈ t, f i • v i = ∑ i ∉ t, f i • v i ∧ ∃ i ∈ t, 0 < f i := by
  simp only [linearIndependent_iffₒₛ, not_forall, pos_iff_ne_zero]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨t, f, heq, i, hfi⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨t, f, heq, i, hi, hfi⟩ =>
    ⟨t, f, heq, i, hfi⟩⟩
  by_cases hi' : i ∈ t
  · exact ⟨t, f, heq, i, hi', hfi⟩
  · refine ⟨tᶜ, f, ?_, i, Finset.mem_compl.2 hi', hfi⟩
    simp [heq]

English
Let $I$ be a finite type. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Assume that $M$ is a module over $R$. Assume that $R$ is a linearly ordered set. Assume that $R$ is a canonically ordered sum. Assume that $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Then $v$ is not independent over $R$, if and only if there exists a finite set $t$ of $I$, such that there exists a function $f$ from $I$ to $R$, such that $\FinsetSum {t}{i}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i)}{v (i)})}$ is equal to $\FinsetSum {\ComplcomplMACRoFU {t}}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ and there exists an element $i_{2}$ of $I$, such that $i_{2}$ is an element of $t$ and $0 < f (i_{2})$.
French
Soit $I$ un type fini. Soit $R$ un semi-anneau. Soit $M$ un monoïde commutatif additif. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$. Supposons que $M$ est un module sur $R$. Supposons que $R$ est un ensemble totalement ordonné. Supposons que $R$ est une somme canoniquement ordonnée. Supposons que $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Alors $v$ n'est pas indépendant sur $R$ si et seulement si il existe un ensemble fini $t$ de $I$ tel que il existe une fonction $f$ de $I$ dans $R$ tel que $\FinsetSum {t}{i}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i)}{v (i)})}$ soit égal à $\FinsetSum {\ComplcomplMACRoFU {t}}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ et il existe un élément $i_{2}$ de $I$ tel que $i_{2}$ soit un élément de $t$ et $0 < f (i_{2})$.

Předpokládejme, že $R$ je lineárně uspořádaná množina. Předpokládejme, že $R$ je kanonicky uspořádaná suma. Předpokládejme, že $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Tedy $v$ není nezávislé nad $R$, právě tehdy, když existuje konečná množina $t$ $I$, takový, že existuje funkce $f$ z $I$ do $R$, takový, že $\FinsetSum {t}{i}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i)}{v (i)})}$ je rovné $\FinsetSum {\ComplcomplMACRoFU {t}}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ a existuje prvek $i_{2}$ z $I$, takový, že $i_{2}$ je element $t$ a $0 < f (i_{2})$.

lemma linearIndepOn_finset_iffₒₛ [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} :
    LinearIndepOn R v s ↔ ∀ t ⊆ s, ∀ (f : ι → R),
      ∑ i ∈ t, f i • v i = ∑ i ∈ s \ t, f i • v i → ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0 := by
  rw [LinearIndepOn, Fintype.linearIndependent_iffₒₛ]
  refine ⟨fun h t ht f heq i hi => h { i | i.1 ∈ t } (f ∘ Subtype.val) ?_ ⟨i, hi⟩,
    fun h t f heq i => ?_⟩
  · simp only [Finset.compl_filter, Finset.sum_filter, Function.comp_apply, Finset.coe_sort_coe]
    rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort s fun i => if i ∈ t then f i • v i else 0,
      Finset.sum_coe_sort s fun i => if i ∉ t then f i • v i else 0]
    simpa [Finset.inter_eq_right.2 ht, Finset.sum_ite, Finset.filter_notMem_eq_sdiff]
  · specialize h (t.map (Embedding.subtype _)) (Finset.map_subtype_subset _)
      (fun i => if h : i ∈ s then f ⟨i, h⟩ else 0) ?_ i i.2
    · conv =>
        enter [2, 1, 1]
        rw [← s.subtype_map_of_mem (fun x hx => hx), Finset.subtype_eq_univ.2 (fun x hx => hx)]
        change Finset.map (Embedding.subtype (· ∈ (s : Set ι))) _
      rw [← Finset.map_sdiff]
      simpa [Embedding.subtype, ← Finset.compl_eq_univ_sdiff]
    simpa using h

Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Assume that $M$ is a module over $R$. Assume that $R$ is a linearly ordered set. Assume that $R$ is a canonically ordered sum. Assume that $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Let $s$ be a finite set of $I$. Then $v$ is independent on $s$ over $R$, if and only if for all finite sets $t$ of $I$, if $t$ is a subset of $s$, then for all functions $f$ from $I$ to $R$, if $\FinsetSum {t}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ is equal to $\FinsetSum {(\SDiffsdiffMACRoEU {s}{t})}{i_{2}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{2})}{v (i_{2})})}$, then for all elements $i$ of $I$, if $i$ is an element of $s$, then $f (i)$ is equal to $0$.

Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a semiring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Assume that $M$ is a module over $R$. Assume that $R$ is a linearly ordered set. Assume that $R$ is a canonically ordered sum. Assume that $\mathrm{IsCancelAdd} (M)$. Let $s$ be a finite set of $I$. Then it is not the case that $v$ is independent on $s$ over $R$, if and only if there exists a finite set $t$ of $I$, such that $t$ is a subset of $s$ and there exists a function $f$ from $I$ to $R$, such that $\FinsetSum {t}{i}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i)}{v (i)})}$ is equal to $\FinsetSum {(\SDiffsdiffMACRoEU {s}{t})}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {f (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ and there exists an element $i_{2}$ of $I$, such that $i_{2}$ is an element of $t$ and $0 < f (i_{2})$.

theorem LinearIndependent.neg (hv : LinearIndependent R v) : LinearIndependent R (-v) := by
  intro f g h
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Pi.neg_apply, smul_neg, Finsupp.sum_neg, neg_inj] at h
  ext m
  congrm $(hv h) m
Dedukti

LinearIndependent__neg : (I : Set) -> (R : Set) -> (M : Set) -> (_ : Proof (Ring R)) -> (_ : Proof (AddCommGroup M)) -> (_ : Proof (Module R M)) -> (v : (Elem I -> M)) -> (hv : Proof (LinearIndependent I R M v)) -> Proof (LinearIndependent I R M (Neg__neg (Elem I -> M) v)).
English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative group such that $M$ is a module over $R$. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$ such that $v$ is independent over $R$. Then the negation of $v$ is independent over $R$.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $R$ un anneau. Soit $M$ un groupe commutatif additif tel que $M$ soit un module sur $R$. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$ telle que $v$ soit indépendant sur $R$. Alors la négation de $v$ est indépendante sur $R$.
Czech
Nechť $I$ je množina. Nechť $R$ je okruh. Nechť $M$ je aditivní komutativní grupa taková, že $M$ je modul nad $R$. Nechť $v$ je funkce z $I$ do $M$ taková, že $v$ je nezávislé nad $R$. Tedy negace $v$ je nezávislá nad $R$.

$I , R , M \in \mathrm{Set} , \mathrm{Ring} (R), \mathrm{AddCommGroup} (M), \mathrm{Module} (R , M), v \in I \rightarrow M , \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (R , v)\vdash \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (R , \NegnegMACRoGE {v})$
Proof

1.Let $f , g \in \FinsuppMACRoDU {I}{R}$ such that $\EqtMACRoDG {\operatorname{linearCombination} (R , \NegnegMACRoGE {v}, f)}{\operatorname{linearCombination} (R , \NegnegMACRoGE {v}, g)}$.intro f g h
2.By simplification, the sum of $f$ and the function that maps $a$ and $b$ to $\HSMulhSMulMACRoEQ {b}{v (a)}$ is equal to the sum of $g$ and the function that maps $a_{1}$ and $b_{1}$ to $\HSMulhSMulMACRoEQ {b_{1}}{v (a_{1})}$.simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Pi.neg_apply, smul_neg, Finsupp.sum_neg, neg_inj] at h
3.Let $m \in I$.ext m
4.It is enough to show that $\EqtMACRoDG {f (m)}{g (m)}$.ext m
5.$\EqtMACRoDG {f (m)}{g (m)}$.congrm $(hv h) m

@[simp] theorem linearIndependent_neg_iff :
    LinearIndependent R (-v) ↔ LinearIndependent R v := by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, LinearIndependent.neg⟩
  simpa using h.neg
Dedukti
1 lines
linearIndependent_neg_iff : (I : Set) -> (R : Set) -> (M : Set) -> (_ : Proof (Ring R)) -> (_ : Proof (AddCommGroup M)) -> (_ : Proof (Module R M)) -> (v : (Elem I -> M)) -> Proof (iff (LinearIndependent I R M (Neg__neg (Elem I -> M) v)) (LinearIndependent I R M v)).
English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative group such that $M$ is a module over $R$. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Then the negation of $v$ is independent over $R$, if and only if $v$ is independent over $R$.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $R$ un anneau. Soit $M$ un groupe commutatif additif tel que $M$ soit un module sur $R$. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$. Alors la négation de $v$ est indépendante sur $R$ si et seulement si $v$ est indépendant sur $R$.
Czech
Nechť $I$ je množina. Nechť $R$ je okruh. Nechť $M$ je aditivní komutativní grupa taková, že $M$ je modul nad $R$. Nechť $v$ je funkce z $I$ do $M$. Tedy negace $v$ je nezávislá nad $R$, právě tehdy, když $v$ je nezávislé nad $R$.
Formula
$I , R , M \in \mathrm{Set} , \mathrm{Ring} (R), \mathrm{AddCommGroup} (M), \mathrm{Module} (R , M), v \in I \rightarrow M \vdash \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (R , \NegnegMACRoGE {v})\leftrightarrow \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (R , v)$
Proof
3 lines
1.Assume that $\NegnegMACRoGE {v}$ is independent over $R$.refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, LinearIndependent.neg⟩
2.It is enough to show that $v$ is independent over $R$.refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, LinearIndependent.neg⟩
3.By simplification, $v$ is independent over $R$.simpa using h.neg
Proof, French
3 lines
1.Supposons que $\NegnegMACRoGE {v}$ est indépendant sur $R$.refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, LinearIndependent.neg⟩
2.Il suffit de montrer que $v$ est indépendant sur $R$.refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, LinearIndependent.neg⟩
3.Par simplification, $v$ est indépendant sur $R$.simpa using h.neg
Proof, Czech
3 lines
1.Předpokládejme, že $\NegnegMACRoGE {v}$ je nezávislé nad $R$.refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, LinearIndependent.neg⟩
2.Stačí ukázat, že $v$ je nezávislé nad $R$.refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, LinearIndependent.neg⟩
3.Zjednodušením, $v$ je nezávislé nad $R$.simpa using h.neg

theorem linearIndependent_iff_ker :
    LinearIndependent R v ↔ LinearMap.ker (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) = ⊥ :=
  LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.symm
Dedukti
2 lines
def linearIndependent_iff_ker : (I : Set) -> (R : Set) -> (M : Set) -> (_ : Proof (Ring R)) -> (_ : Proof (AddCommGroup M)) -> (_ : Proof (Module R M)) -> (v : (Elem I -> M)) -> Proof (iff (LinearIndependent I R M v) (Eqt (Submodule R (Finsupp I R)) (LinearMap__ker R R (Finsupp I R) M (RingHom__id R) (Finsupp__linearCombination I M R v)) (Bot__bot (Submodule R (Finsupp I R))))) :=
  I => R => M => x => x1 => x2 => v => Iff__symm (Eqt (Submodule R (Finsupp I R)) (LinearMap__ker R R (Finsupp I R) M (RingHom__id R) (Finsupp__linearCombination I M R v)) (Bot__bot (Submodule R (Finsupp I R)))) (Function__Injective (Finsupp I R) M (Finsupp__linearCombination I M R v)) (LinearMap__ker_eq_bot R R (Finsupp I R) M (RingHom__id R) (Finsupp__linearCombination I M R v)).
English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative group such that $M$ is a module over $R$. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Then $v$ is independent over $R$, if and only if the kernel of the linear combination of $R$ and $v$ is equal to the bottom.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $R$ un anneau. Soit $M$ un groupe commutatif additif tel que $M$ soit un module sur $R$. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$. Alors $v$ est indépendant sur $R$ si et seulement si le noyau de la combinaison linéaire de $R$ et $v$ est égal à $\BotbotMACRoE$.
Czech
Nechť $I$ je množina. Nechť $R$ je okruh. Nechť $M$ je aditivní komutativní grupa taková, že $M$ je modul nad $R$. Nechť $v$ je funkce z $I$ do $M$. Tedy $v$ je nezávislé nad $R$, právě tehdy, když jádro lineární kombinace $R$ a $v$ je rovné dnu.
Formula
$I , R , M \in \mathrm{Set} , \mathrm{Ring} (R), \mathrm{AddCommGroup} (M), \mathrm{Module} (R , M), v \in I \rightarrow M \vdash \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (R , v)\leftrightarrow \EqtMACRoDG {\operatorname{ker} (\operatorname{linearCombination} (R , v))}{\BotbotMACRoE}$
Proof
2 lines
1.The kernel of the linear combination of $R$ and $v$ is equal to $\BotbotMACRoE$, if and only if the linear combination of $R$ and $v$ is injective.LinearMap.ker_eq_bot
2.The linear combination of $R$ and $v$ is injective, if and only if the kernel of the linear combination of $R$ and $v$ is equal to $\BotbotMACRoE$.Iff.symm 1

2 lines

2.La combinaison linéaire de $R$ et $v$ est injective si et seulement si le noyau de la combinaison linéaire de $R$ et $v$ est égal à $\BotbotMACRoE$.Iff.symm 1
Proof, Czech
2 lines
1.Jádro lineární kombinace $R$ a $v$ je rovné $\BotbotMACRoE$, právě tehdy, když lineární kombinace $R$ a $v$ je injektivní.LinearMap.ker_eq_bot
2.Lineární kombinace $R$ a $v$ je injektivní, právě tehdy, když jádro lineární kombinace $R$ a $v$ je rovné $\BotbotMACRoE$.Iff.symm 1

linearIndependent_iff'theoremDefs.lean:729
A version of linearIndependent_iff where the linear combination is a Finset sum.
Lean
theorem linearIndependent_iff' :
    LinearIndependent R v ↔
      ∀ s : Finset ι, ∀ g : ι → R, ∑ i ∈ s, g i • v i = 0 → ∀ i ∈ s, g i = 0 := by
  rw [linearIndependent_iff'ₛ]
  refine ⟨fun h s f ↦ ?_, fun h s f g ↦ ?_⟩

linearIndependent_iff' : (I : Set) -> (R : Set) -> (M : Set) -> (_ : Proof (Ring R)) -> (_ : Proof (AddCommGroup M)) -> (_ : Proof (Module R M)) -> (v : (Elem I -> M)) -> Proof (iff (LinearIndependent I R M v) (forall (Finset I) (s => forall (Elem I -> R) (g => if (Eqt M (Finset__sum I M s (i1 => HSMul__hSMul R M M (g i1) (v i1))) 0) (forall I (i => if (Membership__mem I (Finset I) s i) (Eqt R (g i) 0))))))).
English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative group such that $M$ is a module over $R$. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Then $v$ is independent over $R$, if and only if for all finite sets $s$ of $I$, for all functions $g$ from $I$ to $R$, if $\FinsetSum {s}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {g (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ is equal to $0$, then for all elements $i$ of $I$, if $i$ is an element of $s$, then $g (i)$ is equal to $0$.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $R$ un anneau. Soit $M$ un groupe commutatif additif tel que $M$ soit un module sur $R$. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$. Alors $v$ est indépendant sur $R$ si et seulement si pour tous les ensembles finis $s$ de $I$, pour toutes les fonctions $g$ de $I$ dans $R$, si $\FinsetSum {s}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {g (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ est égal à $0$, alors pour tous les éléments $i$ de $I$, si $i$ est un élément de $s$, alors $g (i)$ est égal à $0$.
Czech

Tedy $v$ je nezávislé nad $R$, právě tehdy, když pro všechny konečné množiny $s$ $I$, pro všechny funkce $g$ z $I$ do $R$, jestliže $\FinsetSum {s}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {g (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ je rovné $0$, pak pro všechny prvky $i$ z $I$, jestliže $i$ je element $s$, pak $g (i)$ je rovné $0$.
Formula

linearIndependent_iff''theoremDefs.lean:740
A version of linearIndependent_iff where the linear combination is a Finset sum of a function with support contained in the Finset.
Lean
theorem linearIndependent_iff'' :
    LinearIndependent R v ↔
      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → R), (∀ i ∉ s, g i = 0) → ∑ i ∈ s, g i • v i = 0 → ∀ i, g i = 0 := by
  classical
  exact linearIndependent_iff'.trans
    ⟨fun H s g hg hv i => if his : i ∈ s then H s g hv i his else hg i his, fun H s g hg i hi => by
      convert
        H s (fun j => if j ∈ s then g j else 0) (fun j hj => ite_eq_right hj)
          (by simp_rw [ite_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_extend_by_zero, hg]) i
      exact (ite_eq_left hi).symm⟩

Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ be an additive commutative group such that $M$ is a module over $R$. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$.     ¬LinearIndepOn R v s ↔ ∃ f : ι → R, ∑ i ∈ s, f i • v i = 0 ∧ ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0 := by

LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_disjointtheoremDefs.lean:802
If the kernel of a linear map is disjoint from the span of a family of vectors, then the family is linearly independent iff it is linearly independent after composing with the linear map.

protected theorem LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_disjoint (f : M →ₗ[R] M')
    (hf_inj : Disjoint (span R (Set.range v)) (LinearMap.ker f)) :
    LinearIndependent R (f ∘ v) ↔ LinearIndependent R v :=
  f.linearIndependent_iff_of_injOn <| LinearMap.injOn_of_disjoint_ker le_rfl hf_inj

English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a ring. Let $M$ and $M'$ be additive commutative groups such that $M$ is a module over $R$ and $M'$ is a module over $R$. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Let $f$ be a linear map of $M$ and $M'$ such that the span of the range of $v$ is disjoint to the kernel of $f$. Then $\FunctioncompMACRoEM {f}{v}$ is independent over $R$, if and only if $v$ is independent over $R$.
French
Soit $I$ un ensemble. Soit $R$ un anneau. Soient $M$ et $M'$ des groupes commutatifs additifs tels que $M$ soit un module sur $R$ et $M'$ soit un module sur $R$. Soit $v$ une fonction de $I$ dans $M$. Soit $f$ une application linéaire de $M$ et $M'$ telle que l'envergure de l'image de $v$ soit disjointe au noyau de $f$. Alors $\FunctioncompMACRoEM {f}{v}$ est indépendant sur $R$ si et seulement si $v$ est indépendant sur $R$.
Czech
Nechť $I$ je množina. Nechť $R$ je okruh. Nechť $M$ a $M'$ je aditivní komutativní grupa taková, že $M$ je modul nad $R$ a $M'$ je modul nad $R$. Nechť $v$ je funkce z $I$ do $M$. Nechť $f$ je lineární zobrazení $M$ a $M'$ takové, že obal rozsahu $v$ je disjunktní do jádra $f$. Tedy kompozice $f$ a $v$ je nezávislá nad $R$, právě tehdy, když $v$ je nezávislé nad $R$.
Formula
$I , R , M , M' \in \mathrm{Set} , \mathrm{Ring} (R), \mathrm{AddCommGroup} (M), \mathrm{AddCommGroup} (M'), \mathrm{Module} (R , M), \mathrm{Module} (R , M'), v \in I \rightarrow M , f \in \mathrm{LinearMap} (\operatorname{id} (R), M , M'), \mathrm{Disjoint} (\SubmodulespanMACRoIC {R}{\operatorname{range} (v)}, \operatorname{ker} (f))\vdash \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (R , \FunctioncompMACRoEV {f}{v})\leftrightarrow \mathrm{LinearIndependent} (R , v)$
Proof
4 lines
1.Assume that the span of the range of $v$ is disjoint to the kernel of $f$.
2.The span of the range of $v$ is less than or equal to the span of the range of $v$.le_rfl
3.$f$ is injective on the span of the range of $v$.LinearMap.injOn_of_disjoint_ker 2, 1
4.$\FunctioncompMACRoEV {f}{v}$ is independent over $R$, if and only if $v$ is independent over $R$. (its derivation, 2 lines, folded)LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_injOn 3
Proof, French
4 lines
1.Supposons que l'envergure de l'image de $v$ est disjointe au noyau de $f$.
2.L'envergure de l'image de $v$ est inférieure ou égale à l'envergure de l'image de $v$.le_rfl
3.$f$ est injectif sur l'envergure de l'image de $v$.LinearMap.injOn_of_disjoint_ker 2, 1
4.$\FunctioncompMACRoEV {f}{v}$ est indépendant sur $R$ si et seulement si $v$ est indépendant sur $R$. (its derivation, 2 lines, folded)LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_injOn 3
Proof, Czech
4 lines
1.Předpokládejme, že obal rozsahu $v$ je disjunktní do jádra $f$.
2.Obal rozsahu $v$ je menší nebo rovný než obal rozsahu $v$.le_rfl
3.$f$ je injektivní na obalu rozsahu $v$.LinearMap.injOn_of_disjoint_ker 2, 1
4.$\FunctioncompMACRoEV {f}{v}$ je nezávislé nad $R$, právě tehdy, když $v$ je nezávislé nad $R$. (its derivation, 2 lines, folded)LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_injOn 3

      ∀ l ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s, (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l = 0 → l = 0 :=
  linearIndepOn_iffₛ.trans ⟨fun h l hl ↦ h l hl 0 (zero_mem _), fun h f hf g hg eq ↦

English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a ring. Let $s \in \wp I$. Let $M$ be an additive commutative group such that $M$ is a module over $R$. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Then $v$ is independent on $s$ over $R$, if and only if for all elements $l$ of $\FinsuppMACRoDN {I}{R}$, if $l$ is an element of $\operatorname{supported} (R , R , s)$, then if $\operatorname{linearCombination} (R , v , l)$ is equal to $0$, then $l$ is equal to $0$.

A version of linearIndepOn_iff where the linear combination is a Finset sum.
Lean
lemma linearIndepOn_iff' : LinearIndepOn R v s ↔ ∀ (t : Finset ι) (g : ι → R), (t : Set ι) ⊆ s →
    ∑ i ∈ t, g i • v i = 0 → ∀ i ∈ t, g i = 0 := by
  classical
  rw [LinearIndepOn, linearIndependent_iff']
  refine ⟨fun h t g hts h0 i hit ↦ ?_, fun h t g h0 i hit ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine h (t.preimage _ Subtype.val_injective.injOn) (fun i ↦ g i) ?_ ⟨i, hts hit⟩ (by simpa)
    rwa [t.sum_preimage ((↑) : s → ι) Subtype.val_injective.injOn (fun i ↦ g i • v i)]
    simp only [Subtype.range_coe_subtype, ofPred_mem_eq]
    exact fun x hxt hxs ↦ (hxs (hts hxt)) |>.elim
  replace h : ∀ i (hi : i ∈ s), ⟨i, hi⟩ ∈ t → ∀ (h : i ∈ s), g ⟨i, h⟩ = 0 := by
    simpa [h0] using h (t.image (↑)) (fun i ↦ if hi : i ∈ s then g ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0)
  apply h _ _ hit

English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a ring. Let $s \in \wp I$. Let $M$ be an additive commutative group such that $M$ is a module over $R$. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Then $v$ is independent on $s$ over $R$, if and only if for all finite sets $t$ of $I$, for all functions $g$ from $I$ to $R$, if $t$ is a subset of $s$, then if $\FinsetSum {t}{i_{1}}{(\HSMulhSMulMACRoEI {g (i_{1})}{v (i_{1})})}$ is equal to $0$, then for all elements $i$ of $I$, if $i$ is an element of $t$, then $g (i)$ is equal to $0$.

linearIndepOn_iff''theoremDefs.lean:852
A version of linearIndepOn_iff where the linear combination is a Finset sum of a function with support contained in the Finset.

lemma linearIndepOn_iff'' : LinearIndepOn R v s ↔ ∀ (t : Finset ι) (g : ι → R), (t : Set ι) ⊆ s →
    (∀ i ∉ t, g i = 0) → ∑ i ∈ t, g i • v i = 0 → ∀ i ∈ t, g i = 0 := by
  classical
  exact linearIndepOn_iff'.trans ⟨fun h t g hts htg h0 ↦ h _ _ hts h0, fun h t g hts h0 ↦
    by simpa +contextual [h0] using h t (fun i ↦ if i ∈ t then g i else 0) hts⟩

Let $I$ be a set. Let $R$ be a ring. Let $s \in \wp I$. Let $M$ be an additive commutative group such that $M$ is a module over $R$. Let $v$ be a function from $I$ to $M$. Lean
@[simp]
theorem det_mul (M N : Matrix n n R) : det (M * N) = det M * det N :=
  calc
    det (M * N) = ∑ p : n → n, ∑ σ : Perm n, ε σ * ∏ i, M (σ i) (p i) * N (p i) i := by
      simp only [det_apply', mul_apply, prod_univ_sum, mul_sum, Fintype.piFinset_univ]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ p : n → n with Bijective p, ∑ σ : Perm n, ε σ * ∏ i, M (σ i) (p i) * N (p i) i := by
      refine (sum_subset (filter_subset _ _) fun f _ hbij ↦ det_mul_aux ?_).symm
      simpa only [mem_filter_univ] using hbij
    _ = ∑ τ : Perm n, ∑ σ : Perm n, ε σ * ∏ i, M (σ i) (τ i) * N (τ i) i :=
      sum_bij (fun p h ↦ Equiv.ofBijective p (mem_filter.1 h).2) (fun _ _ ↦ mem_univ _)
        (fun _ _ _ _ h ↦ by injection h)
        (fun b _ ↦ ⟨b, mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_univ _, b.bijective⟩, coe_fn_injective rfl⟩) fun _ _ ↦ rfl
    _ = ∑ σ : Perm n, ∑ τ : Perm n, (∏ i, N (σ i) i) * ε τ * ∏ j, M (τ j) (σ j) := by
      simp only [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, prod_mul_distrib, mul_assoc]
    _ = ∑ σ : Perm n, ∑ τ : Perm n, (∏ i, N (σ i) i) * (ε σ * ε τ) * ∏ i, M (τ i) i :=
      (sum_congr rfl fun σ _ =>
        Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mulRight σ⁻¹) _ _ fun τ => by
          have : (∏ j, M (τ j) (σ j)) = ∏ j, M ((τ * σ⁻¹) j) j := by
            rw [← (σ⁻¹ : _ ≃ _).prod_comp]
            simp
          have h : ε σ * ε (τ * σ⁻¹) = ε τ :=
            calc
              ε σ * ε (τ * σ⁻¹) = ε (τ * σ⁻¹ * σ) := by
                rw [mul_comm, sign_mul (τ * σ⁻¹)]
                simp only [Int.cast_mul, Units.val_mul]
              _ = ε τ := by simp only [inv_mul_cancel_right]
          simp_rw [Equiv.coe_mulRight, h]
          simp only [this])
    _ = det M * det N := by
      simp only [det_apply', Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]

Matrix__det_mul : (n : Set) -> (_ : Proof (Fintype n)) -> (R : Set) -> (_ : Proof (CommRing R)) -> (M : (Matrix n n R)) -> (N : (Matrix n n R)) -> Proof (Eqt R (Matrix__det n R (times M N)) (times (Matrix__det n R M) (Matrix__det n R N))).
English
Let $n$ be a finite type. Let $R$ be a commutative ring. Let $M$ and $N$ be matrixes of $n$ and $R$. Then the determinant of $M \times N$ is equal to $\MatrixdetMACRoGY {M}\times \MatrixdetMACRoGY {N}$.

theorem det_transpose (M : Matrix n n R) : Mᵀ.det = M.det := by

  refine Fintype.sum_bijective _ inv_involutive.bijective _ _ ?_

  congr 1
  apply Fintype.prod_equiv σ
  simp

Permuting rows and columns with the same equivalence does not change the determinant.

@[simp]
theorem det_submatrix_equiv_self (e : n ≃ m) (A : Matrix m m R) :
    det (A.submatrix e e) = det A := by
  rw [det_apply', det_apply']
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.permCongr e)
  intro σ
  rw [Equiv.Perm.sign_permCongr e σ]
  congr 1
  apply Fintype.prod_equiv e
  intro i
  rw [Equiv.permCongr_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, submatrix_apply]

Matrix.abs_det_submatrix_equiv_equivtheoremBasic.lean:241
Permuting rows and columns with two equivalences does not change the absolute value of the determinant.
Lean
@[simp]
theorem abs_det_submatrix_equiv_equiv {R : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    (e₁ e₂ : n ≃ m) (A : Matrix m m R) :
    |(A.submatrix e₁ e₂).det| = |A.det| := by
  have hee : e₂ = e₁.trans (e₁.symm.trans e₂) := by ext; simp
  rw [hee]
  change |((A.submatrix id (e₁.symm.trans e₂)).submatrix e₁ e₁).det| = |A.det|
  rw [Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self, Matrix.det_permute', abs_mul, abs_unit_intCast, one_mul]

Let $A$ be a matrix of $m$ and $R$. Then the absolute value of the determinant of the submatrix of $e_{1}$ and $e_{2}$ is equal to $\absMACRoP {\MatrixdetMACRoGY {A}}$.

Matrix.det_reindex_selftheoremBasic.lean:255
Reindexing both indices along the same equivalence preserves the determinant.
For the simp version of this lemma, see det_submatrix_equiv_self; this one is unsuitable because Matrix.reindex_apply unfolds reindex first.
Lean
theorem det_reindex_self (e : m ≃ n) (A : Matrix m m R) : det (reindex e e A) = det A :=
  det_submatrix_equiv_self e.symm A

  m => n => x1 => x3 => R => x4 => e => A => Matrix__det_submatrix_equiv_self m n R (Equiv__symm m n e) A.

lemma det_reindex (e e' : m ≃ n) (M : Matrix m m R) :
    (M.reindex e e').det = sign (e'.trans e.symm) * M.det := by
  trans ((M.reindex (e.trans e'.symm) (.refl _)).reindex e' e').det
  · congr 1; ext; simp
  · simp_rw [det_reindex_self, reindex_apply, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl, det_permute]
    rfl

theorem det_smul (A : Matrix n n R) (c : R) : det (c • A) = c ^ Fintype.card n * det A :=
  calc
    det (c • A) = det ((diagonal fun _ => c) * A) := by rw [smul_eq_diagonal_mul]
    _ = det (diagonal fun _ => c) * det A := det_mul _ _
    _ = c ^ Fintype.card n * det A := by simp

theorem det_mul_row (v : n → R) (A : Matrix n n R) :
    det (of fun i j => v j * A i j) = (∏ i, v i) * det A :=
  calc
    det (of fun i j => v j * A i j) = det (A * diagonal v) :=
      congr(det $(by
        ext
        simp [mul_comm]))
    _ = (∏ i, v i) * det A := by rw [det_mul, det_diagonal, mul_comm]

theorem det_mul_column (v : n → R) (A : Matrix n n R) :
    det (of fun i j => v i * A i j) = (∏ i, v i) * det A :=
  MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ _ v A

Matrix.det_updateCol_eq_zerotheoremBasic.lean:386
If we repeat a column of a matrix, we get a matrix of determinant zero.
Lean
theorem det_updateCol_eq_zero (h : i ≠ j) :
    (M.updateCol j (fun k ↦ M k i)).det = 0 := det_zero_of_column_eq h (by simp [h])

theorem det_eq_of_eq_mul_det_one {A B : Matrix n n R} (C : Matrix n n R) (hC : det C = 1)

theorem det_vecMulVec [Nontrivial n] (u v : n → R) : (vecMulVec u v).det = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ := exists_pair_ne n
  let uv' := ((vecMulVec u v).updateRow i v).updateRow j v
  have huv' : uv'.det = 0 := by
    refine detRowAlternating.map_eq_zero_of_eq _ ?_ hij
    simp [uv', hij]
  have : vecMulVec u v =
      (uv'.updateRow i (u i • uv' i)).updateRow j (u j • uv'.updateRow i (u i • uv' i) j) := by
    unfold uv'
    rw [updateRow_comm _ hij, updateRow_idem, updateRow_ne hij.symm, updateRow_ne hij,
      updateRow_self, updateRow_self, updateRow_comm _ hij, updateRow_idem,
      ← update_vecMulVec u v j, update_eq_self, ← update_vecMulVec u v i, update_eq_self]
  rw [this, det_updateRow_smul, updateRow_eq_self, det_updateRow_smul, updateRow_eq_self, huv',
    mul_zero, mul_zero]

Lean
theorem det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_const_aux {A B : Matrix n n R} {s : Finset n} :
    ∀ (c : n → R) (_ : ∀ i, i ∉ s → c i = 0) (k : n) (_ : k ∉ s)
      (_ : ∀ i j, A i j = B i j + c i * B k j), det A = det B := by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing B with
  | empty =>
    rintro c hs k - A_eq
    have : ∀ i, c i = 0 := by grind
    congr
    ext i j
    rw [A_eq, this, zero_mul, add_zero]
  | insert i s _hi ih =>
    intro c hs k hk A_eq
    have hAi : A i = B i + c i • B k := funext (A_eq i)
    rw [@ih (updateRow B i (A i)) (Function.update c i 0), hAi, det_updateRow_add_smul_self]
    · exact mt (fun h => show k ∈ insert i s from h ▸ Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) hk
    · intro i' hi'
      rw [Function.update_apply]
      split_ifs with hi'i
      · rfl
      · exact hs i' fun h => hi' ((Finset.mem_insert.mp h).resolve_left hi'i)
    · exact k
    · exact fun h => hk (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h)
    · intro i' j'
      rw [updateRow_apply, Function.update_apply]
      split_ifs with hi'i
      · simp [hi'i]
      rw [A_eq, updateRow_ne fun h : k = i => hk <| h ▸ Finset.mem_insert_self k s]

English
Let $n$ be a finite type. Let $R$ be a commutative ring. Let $A$ and $B$ be matrixes of $n$ and $R$. Let $s$ be a finite set of $n$. Let $c$ be a function from $n$ to $R$ such that for all elements $i_{1}$ of $n$, if $i_{1}$ is not an element of $s$, then $c (i_{1})$ is equal to $0$. Let $k \in n$ such that $k$ is not an element of $s$ and for all elements $i$ and $j$ of $n$, $A (i , j)$ is equal to $B (i , j)+ c (i)\times B (k , j)$. Then the determinant of $A$ is equal to the determinant of $B$.
French
Soit $n$ un type fini. Soit $R$ un anneau commutatif. Soient $A$ et $B$ des matrices de $n$ et $R$. Soit $s$ un ensemble fini de $n$. Soit $c$ une fonction de $n$ dans $R$ telle que pour tous les éléments $i_{1}$ de $n$, si $i_{1}$ n'est pas un élément de $s$, alors $c (i_{1})$ soit égal à $0$. Soit $k \in n$ tel que $k$ n'est pas un élément de $s$ et pour tous les éléments $i$ et $j$ de $n$, $A (i , j)$ est égal à $B (i , j)+ c (i)\times B (k , j)$. Alors le déterminant de $A$ est égal au déterminant de $B$.

If you add multiples of row B k to other rows, the determinant doesn't change.
Lean
theorem det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_const {A B : Matrix n n R} (c : n → R) (k : n)
    (hk : c k = 0) (A_eq : ∀ i j, A i j = B i j + c i * B k j) : det A = det B :=

Matrix__det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_const : (n : Set) -> (_ : Proof (Fintype n)) -> (R : Set) -> (_ : Proof (CommRing R)) -> (A : (Matrix n n R)) -> (B : (Matrix n n R)) -> (c : (Elem n -> R)) -> (k : Elem n) -> (hk : Proof (Eqt R (c k) 0)) -> (A_eq : Proof (forall n (i => forall n (j => Eqt R (A i j) (plus (B i j) (times (c i) (B k j))))))) -> Proof (Eqt R (Matrix__det n R A) (Matrix__det n R B)).
English
Let $n$ be a finite type. Let $R$ be a commutative ring. Let $A$ and $B$ be matrixes of $n$ and $R$. Let $c$ be a function from $n$ to $R$. Let $k \in n$ such that $c (k)$ is equal to $0$ and for all elements $i$ and $j$ of $n$, $A (i , j)$ is equal to $B (i , j)+ c (i)\times B (k , j)$. Then the determinant of $A$ is equal to the determinant of $B$.
French
Soit $n$ un type fini. Soit $R$ un anneau commutatif. Soient $A$ et $B$ des matrices de $n$ et $R$. Soit $c$ une fonction de $n$ dans $R$. Soit $k \in n$ tel que $c (k)$ est égal à $0$ et pour tous les éléments $i$ et $j$ de $n$, $A (i , j)$ est égal à $B (i , j)+ c (i)\times B (k , j)$. Alors le déterminant de $A$ est égal au déterminant de $B$.
Czech
Nechť $n$ je konečný typ. Nechť $R$ je komutativní okruh. Nechť $A$ a $B$ je matice $n$ a $R$. Nechť $c$ je funkce z $n$ do $R$. Nechť $k \in n$ takový, že $c (k)$ je rovné $0$ a pro všechny prvky $i$ a $j$ z $n$, $A (i , j)$ je rovné $B (i , j)+ c (i)\times B (k , j)$. Tedy determinant $A$ je rovný determinantu $B$.
Formula
$n \in \mathrm{Set} , \mathrm{Fintype} (n), R \in \mathrm{Set} , \mathrm{CommRing} (R), A , B \in \mathrm{Matrix} (n , n , R), c \in n \rightarrow R , k \in n , \EqtMACRoDG {c (k)}{0}, \forall i \in n . \forall j \in n . \EqtMACRoDG {A (i , j)}{B (i , j)+ c (i)\times B (k , j)}\vdash \EqtMACRoDG {\MatrixdetMACRoHK {A}}{\MatrixdetMACRoHK {B}}$

theorem det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_pred_aux {n : ℕ} (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∀ (c : Fin n → R) (_hc : ∀ i : Fin n, k < i.succ → c i = 0)
      {M N : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R} (_h0 : ∀ j, M 0 j = N 0 j)
      (_hsucc : ∀ (i : Fin n) (j), M i.succ j = N i.succ j + c i * M (Fin.castSucc i) j),
      det M = det N := by
  refine Fin.induction ?_ (fun k ih => ?_) k <;> intro c hc M N h0 hsucc
  · congr
    ext i j
    refine Fin.cases (h0 j) (fun i => ?_) i
    rw [hsucc, hc i (Fin.succ_pos _), zero_mul, add_zero]
  set M' := updateRow M k.succ (N k.succ) with hM'
  have hM : M = updateRow M' k.succ (M' k.succ + c k • M (Fin.castSucc k)) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hi : i = k.succ
    · simp [hi, hM', hsucc, updateRow_self]
    rw [updateRow_ne hi, hM', updateRow_ne hi]
  have k_ne_succ : (Fin.castSucc k) ≠ k.succ := Fin.castSucc_lt_succ.ne
  have M_k : M (Fin.castSucc k) = M' (Fin.castSucc k) := (updateRow_ne k_ne_succ).symm
  rw [hM, M_k, det_updateRow_add_smul_self M' k_ne_succ.symm, ih (Function.update c k 0)]
  · intro i hi
    rw [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at hi
    rw [Function.update_apply]
    split_ifs with hik
    · rfl
    exact hc _ (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne hi (Ne.symm hik)))
  · rwa [hM', updateRow_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm]
  intro i j
  rw [Function.update_apply]
  split_ifs with hik
  · rw [zero_mul, add_zero, hM', hik, updateRow_self]
  rw [hM', updateRow_ne ((Fin.succ_injective _).ne hik), hsucc]
  by_cases hik2 : k < i
  · simp [hc i (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mpr hik2)]
  rw [updateRow_ne]
  apply ne_of_lt
  rwa [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ, Nat.lt_succ_iff, ← not_lt]

theorem det_eq_of_forall_col_eq_smul_add_pred {n : ℕ} {A B : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R}
    (c : Fin n → R) (A_zero : ∀ i, A i 0 = B i 0)
    (A_succ : ∀ (i) (j : Fin n), A i j.succ = B i j.succ + c j * A i (Fin.castSucc j)) :
    det A = det B := by
  rw [← det_transpose A, ← det_transpose B]
  exact det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_pred c A_zero fun i j => A_succ j i

@[simp]
theorem det_blockDiagonal {o : Type*} [Fintype o] [DecidableEq o] (M : o → Matrix n n R) :
    (blockDiagonal M).det = ∏ k, (M k).det := by
  -- Rewrite the determinants as a sum over permutations.
  simp_rw [det_apply']
  -- The right-hand side is a product of sums, rewrite it as a sum of products.
  rw [Finset.prod_sum]
  simp_rw [Finset.prod_attach_univ, Finset.univ_pi_univ]
  -- We claim that the only permutations contributing to the sum are those that
  -- preserve their second component.
  let preserving_snd : Finset (Equiv.Perm (n × o)) := {σ | ∀ x, (σ x).snd = x.snd}
  have mem_preserving_snd :
    ∀ {σ : Equiv.Perm (n × o)}, σ ∈ preserving_snd ↔ ∀ x, (σ x).snd = x.snd := fun {σ} =>
    Finset.mem_filter.trans ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩⟩
  rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ preserving_snd) _]
  -- And that these are in bijection with `o → Equiv.Perm m`.
  · refine (Finset.sum_bij (fun σ _ => prodCongrLeft fun k ↦ σ k (mem_univ k)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).symm
    · intro σ _
      rw [mem_preserving_snd]
      rintro ⟨-, x⟩
      simp only [prodCongrLeft_apply]
    · intro σ _ σ' _ eq
      ext x hx k
      have :
        ∀ k x,
          prodCongrLeft (fun k => σ k (Finset.mem_univ _)) (k, x) =
            prodCongrLeft (fun k => σ' k (Finset.mem_univ _)) (k, x) :=
        fun k x => by rw [eq]
      simp only [prodCongrLeft_apply, Prod.mk_inj] at this
      exact (this k x).1
    · intro σ hσ
      rw [mem_preserving_snd] at hσ
      have hσ' x : (σ.symm x).snd = x.snd := by simpa [eq_comm] using hσ (σ.symm x)
      have mk_apply_eq : ∀ k x, ((σ (x, k)).fst, k) = σ (x, k) := by
        intro k x
        ext
        · simp only
        · simp only [hσ]
      have mk_inv_apply_eq : ∀ k x, ((σ.symm (x, k)).fst, k) = σ.symm (x, k) := by grind

Let $n$ and $o$ be finite types. Let $R$ be a commutative ring. Let $M$ be a function from elements of $o$ to matrixes of $n$ and $R$. Then the determinant of the block diagonal of $M$ is equal to $\FinsetProd {\FinsetunivMACRoDZ}{k}{\MatrixdetMACRoGY {M (k)}}$.

The determinant of a 2×2 block matrix with the lower-left block equal to zero is the product of the determinants of the diagonal blocks. For the generalization to any number of blocks, see Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular.

Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂theoremBasic.lean:728
The determinant of a 2×2 block matrix with the upper-right block equal to zero is the product of the determinants of the diagonal blocks. For the generalization to any number of blocks, see Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular.
Lean
@[simp]
theorem det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂ (A : Matrix m m R) (C : Matrix n m R) (D : Matrix n n R) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 C D).det = A.det * D.det := by
  rw [← det_transpose, fromBlocks_transpose, transpose_zero, det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, det_transpose,
    det_transpose]

Matrix.det_succ_column_zerotheoremBasic.lean:734
Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an n+1 × n+1 matrix along column 0.
Lean
theorem det_succ_column_zero {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R) :
    det A = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, (-1) ^ (i : ℕ) * A i 0 * det (A.submatrix i.succAbove Fin.succ) := by
  rw [Matrix.det_apply, Finset.univ_perm_fin_succ, ← Finset.univ_product_univ]
  simp only [Finset.sum_map, Equiv.toEmbedding_apply, Finset.sum_product, Matrix.submatrix]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
  · simp only [Fin.prod_univ_succ, Matrix.det_apply, Finset.mul_sum,
      Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_apply_zero, Fin.val_zero, one_mul,
      Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm_sign, Equiv.swap_self, ite_true, id,
      Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_apply_succ, Fin.succAbove_zero, Equiv.coe_refl, pow_zero,
      mul_smul_comm, of_apply]
  -- `univ_perm_fin_succ` gives a different embedding of `Perm (Fin n)` into
  -- `Perm (Fin n.succ)` than the determinant of the submatrix we want,
  -- permute `A` so that we get the correct one.
  have : (-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ) = (Perm.sign i.cycleRange) := by simp [Fin.sign_cycleRange]
  rw [Fin.val_succ, pow_succ', this, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm (ε _),
    ← det_permute, Matrix.det_apply, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  -- now we just need to move the corresponding parts to the same place
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
  rw [Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm_sign, ite_eq_right (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)]
  calc
    ((-1 * Perm.sign σ : ℤ) • ∏ i', A (Perm.decomposeFin.symm (Fin.succ i, σ) i') i') =
        (-1 * Perm.sign σ : ℤ) • (A (Fin.succ i) 0 *
          ∏ i', A ((Fin.succ i).succAbove (Fin.cycleRange i (σ i'))) i'.succ) := by
      simp only [Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.succAbove_cycleRange,
        Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_apply_zero, Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_apply_succ]
    _ = -1 * (A (Fin.succ i) 0 * (Perm.sign σ : ℤ) •
        ∏ i', A ((Fin.succ i).succAbove (Fin.cycleRange i (σ i'))) i'.succ) := by
      simp [_root_.neg_mul, one_mul, zsmul_eq_mul, neg_smul,
        Fin.succAbove_cycleRange, mul_left_comm]

Matrix.det_succ_row_zerotheoremBasic.lean:765
Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an n+1 × n+1 matrix along row 0.
Lean
theorem det_succ_row_zero {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R) :
    det A = ∑ j : Fin n.succ, (-1) ^ (j : ℕ) * A 0 j * det (A.submatrix Fin.succ j.succAbove) := by
  rw [← det_transpose A, det_succ_column_zero]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [← det_transpose]
  simp only [transpose_apply, transpose_submatrix, transpose_transpose]

Let $R$ be a commutative ring. Let $n \in \Natural$. Let $A$ be a matrix of $\FinMACRoHJ {\mathrm{succ} (n)}$ and $R$. Then the determinant of $A$ is equal to $\FinsetSum {\FinsetunivMACRoDZ}{j}{(\NegnegMACRoFV {1}^ {j}\times A (0 , j)\times \MatrixdetMACRoGY {\operatorname{submatrix} (A , \operatorname{succ} , \operatorname{succAbove} (j))})}$.

Matrix.det_succ_rowtheoremBasic.lean:773
Laplacian expansion of the determinant of an n+1 × n+1 matrix along row i.
Lean
theorem det_succ_row {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n.succ) (Fin n.succ) R) (i : Fin n.succ) :
    det A =
      ∑ j : Fin n.succ, (-1) ^ (i + j : ℕ) * A i j * det (A.submatrix i.succAbove j.succAbove) := by
  simp_rw [pow_add, mul_assoc, ← mul_sum]
  have : det A = (-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ) * (Perm.sign i.cycleRange⁻¹) * det A := by
    calc
      det A = ↑((-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (i : ℕ) : ℤˣ) * det A := by simp
      _ = (-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ) * (Perm.sign i.cycleRange⁻¹) * det A := by simp [-Int.units_mul_self]
  rw [this, mul_assoc]
  congr
  rw [← det_permute, det_succ_row_zero]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [mul_assoc, Matrix.submatrix_apply, submatrix_submatrix, id_comp, Function.comp_def, id]
  simp
